title: Philippines vs Thailand: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Philippines for beaches and English fluency; Thailand for food, infrastructure, and first-timer ease. Do both in 3+ weeks.

categories.name: Beaches & Islands
categories.summary: El Nido, Boracay, and Siargao are world-class. Thailand has excellent beaches but the Philippines wins on raw natural beauty.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Thai cuisine is globally celebrated. Filipino food has highlights but can't match Thailand's street food depth and variety.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Thailand's metro, cheap flights, and trains make multi-destination travel easy. Philippines logistics require more planning.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Both are $50–90/day mid-range. Philippines domestic flights add up. Thailand is more predictable for budgeting.

categories.name: English & Culture
categories.summary: English is an official language in the Philippines. Thailand ranks 106th globally on English proficiency.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Both are safe in tourist areas. Thailand is more consistently safe throughout. Philippines requires awareness in some city areas.

categories.name: Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: Thailand's two coasts allow year-round beach travel. Philippines typhoon season (June–Oct) limits options.

categories.name: Digital Nomad
categories.summary: Thailand wins on internet reliability and nomad infrastructure. Philippines wins on visa flexibility.

categories.name: Diving & Snorkeling
categories.summary: Philippines is world-class for diving: Coron wrecks, Tubbataha Reef, sea turtles. Thailand's Ko Tao is great for budget PADI.

faq.question: Is the Philippines or Thailand better for beaches?
faq.answer: Philippines — El Nido, Boracay, and Siargao are consistently ranked among Southeast Asia's best beaches.

faq.question: Is it easier to travel in Thailand or the Philippines?
faq.answer: Thailand is significantly easier — metro, cheap domestic flights, overnight trains, and reliable ferries.

faq.question: Which has better food, Philippines or Thailand?
faq.answer: Thailand wins convincingly — Thai cuisine is one of the world's great cuisines. Filipino food has highlights but doesn't match Thailand's street food depth.
